binary64.execution_note: Functions root, score, objective, moments, result specify arithmetic only. Production types/schema validation must enforce the separate closed domains before evaluating them. Assertions in this specification denote mandatory terminal checks, never Python optimization-dependent assertions. Production cannot import this temp file.
binary64.integer_zero_reason: 49*(13 zeros + 36 ones sum)==36*49, yet prescribed floating U(0)=-0x1.1000000000000p-49 on frozen runtime; integer bypass is authoritative.
binary64.moment_bounds: finite beta within [-26722.0,26722.0]; outputs finite; shifted exponential underflow to +0.0 at intermediate bracket evaluations permitted, denominator must stay strictly positive. No final clipping, flooring, renormalizing, root rounding or solver substitution.
binary64.normative_program:
N = (6096454, 5775588, 1851150, 246820, 13545, 258, 1)
LOG_N = float.fromhex('0x1.07412c1f4cc68p+4')
FAIR = 6.0/49.0

def moments(beta):
    if beta == 0.0:
        return 36.0/49.0, 258.0/49.0, LOG_N
    a = tuple(beta * float(k) for k in range(7))
    maximum = max(a)
    weights = tuple(float(N[k]) * math.exp(a[k] - maximum) for k in range(7))
    denominator = math.fsum(weights)
    mean = math.fsum(float(k)*weights[k] for k in range(7))/denominator
    complement = math.fsum(float(6-k)*weights[k] for k in range(7))/denominator
    log_z = maximum + math.log(denominator)
    return mean, complement, log_z

def score(beta, counts):
    mean, _, _ = moments(beta)
    return math.fsum([-beta, *(float(k) - mean for k in counts)])

def objective(beta, counts):
    _, _, log_z = moments(beta)
    return math.fsum([-0.5*(beta*beta), *(beta*float(k)-log_z for k in counts)])

def root(counts):
    residual = 49*sum(counts)-36*len(counts)
    if not counts or residual == 0:
        return 0.0
    bound = float(6*len(counts)+64)
    at_zero = score(0.0, counts)
    assert (at_zero>0.0) == (residual>0) and at_zero != 0.0
    lo, hi = (0.0, bound) if residual > 0 else (-bound, 0.0)
    assert score(lo, counts)>0.0 and score(hi, counts)<0.0
    for _ in range(256):
        midpoint = lo+(hi-lo)/2.0
        if score(midpoint, counts)>0.0:
            lo = midpoint
        else:
            hi = midpoint
    result = lo+(hi-lo)/2.0
    assert result != 0.0 and (result>0.0) == (residual>0)
    return result

def result(beta):
    mean, complement, log_z = moments(beta)
    p_in, p_out = (FAIR, FAIR) if beta == 0.0 else (mean/6.0, complement/43.0)
    values = dict(beta=beta,mean=mean,complement_mean=complement,log_z=log_z,p_in=p_in,p_out=p_out,expected_six=math.fsum([p_in]*6+[p_out]*43))
    assert 0.0<p_in<1.0 and 0.0<p_out<1.0 and abs(values['expected_six']-6.0)<=1e-12
    return {name: {'hex': value.hex(), 'decimal': value} for name,value in values.items()}
